description: A planner released a load for tendering. Published only by transport. Transport MUST fill data.releasedBy and data.legalEntityScope from the gateway-verified principal of the release request (X-Passage-User and X-Passage-Legal-Entity), never from the request body or the load row, and MUST NOT publish the event when the load's legal entity is outside that scope. workflow-ts mints the tender's scoped=true transport token from these two fields, so they are the only evidence of the releasing user's scope.

releaseId.description: transport's id of the release; workflow-ts keys the tender start on it, so a redelivered release replays the same tender

legalEntityId.description: the load's legal entity; must be in legalEntityScope

releasedBy.description: user id of the verified principal that released the load (X-Passage-User), not a body field

legalEntityScope.description: legal entities of the verified principal (X-Passage-Legal-Entity), not a body field

carriers.description: carriers in rank order, each once
